note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.flaggedIssues via flagsHint "detectFlaggedIssues" with flagsArgs ["state","result"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectFlaggedIssues(state, grade); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.

personas.name: normal-without-potassium
personas.description: Routine ward panel, potassium not entered: anion gap 10 mmol/L, within the potassium-exclusive reference range (8-12) — normal.

firedRules.description: Anion gap within the normal reference range

personas.name: high-hagma-with-potassium
personas.description: Early diabetic ketoacidosis on the acute medical unit: potassium-inclusive anion gap 17.5 mmol/L, above the potassium-inclusive upper limit (16) but below the very-high threshold (20) — high, prompting the GOLDMARK/MUDPILES differential.

context.clinicalContext: New hyperglycaemia, mild ketosis, early suspected DKA

firedRules.description: Anion gap above the normal upper bound — high anion gap metabolic acidosis

flaggedIssues.description: The anion gap 17.5 mmol/L is above the 16 mmol/L upper reference limit — suggests a high anion gap metabolic acidosis
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Investigate the cause: work through the GOLDMARK / MUDPILES differential and correlate with the clinical picture.

personas.name: very-high-severe-acidosis
personas.description: Intensive-care sepsis with severe lactic acidosis: anion gap 29 mmol/L, at or above the very-high threshold (20) — marked elevation, urgent flag.

firedRules.description: Anion gap at or above 20 mmol/L — very high, urgent

flaggedIssues.description: The anion gap 29.0 mmol/L is at or above the 20 mmol/L very-high threshold — marked elevation
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Urgent: search for the cause of the metabolic acidosis without delay (GOLDMARK / MUDPILES); check lactate, ketones, renal function, and a toxicology history.

personas.name: hypoalbuminaemia-masking
personas.description: Critically ill patient with severe hypoalbuminaemia: the raw anion gap (10 mmol/L) looks normal, but the albumin correction (albumin 15 g/L) raises it to 16.25 mmol/L — above the potassium-exclusive upper limit. The uncorrected value would falsely reassure.

context.clinicalContext: Prolonged ICU stay, nutritional deficit, low albumin

note.clinicalNote: Corrected gap flagged despite reassuring raw value

firedRules.description: Anion gap above the normal upper bound — high anion gap metabolic acidosis

flaggedIssues.description: The albumin-corrected anion gap 16.3 mmol/L is above the 12 mmol/L upper reference limit — suggests a high anion gap metabolic acidosis
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Investigate the cause: work through the GOLDMARK / MUDPILES differential and correlate with the clinical picture.

flaggedIssues.description: The uncorrected anion gap 10.0 mmol/L looks normal, but the albumin-corrected gap 16.3 mmol/L is raised
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Do not be reassured by the raw gap: hypoalbuminaemia is masking a raised anion gap. Investigate as a high anion gap acidosis.

personas.name: low-anion-gap
personas.description: Multiple myeloma with a paraprotein gammopathy: anion gap 5 mmol/L, below the lower reference limit (8) — low, prompting consideration of paraproteinaemia, lithium toxicity, or laboratory error.

context.clinicalContext: Known IgG multiple myeloma, routine bloods

flaggedIssues.description: The anion gap 5.0 mmol/L is below the 8 mmol/L lower reference limit
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Consider hypoalbuminaemia (if uncorrected), laboratory error, paraproteinaemia, or lithium / bromide toxicity.

personas.name: incomplete-missing-bicarbonate
personas.description: Laboratory result still pending: sodium and chloride entered but bicarbonate not yet back — the anion gap cannot be computed and the calculation is unknown, not zero.

context.clinicalContext: Bicarbonate pending, will re-run once available

firedRules.description: Anion gap not computed — sodium, chloride and/or bicarbonate is missing

flaggedIssues.description: Missing input(s): serum bicarbonate — the anion gap cannot be computed
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Complete the serum electrolyte panel (sodium, chloride, bicarbonate), then re-calculate.
